papers.title: Very fast 2D inversions of Stokes profiles using neural emulators
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 appendices, 5 figures, submitted to A&A
papers.summary: Neural emulators of photospheric and chromospheric Stokes profiles enable fast regularized 2D solar inversions, processing full fields of view in minutes on a GPU.

papers.title: Scaling and Cross-Simulation Generalization of Graph Neural Networks for Cosmic-Web Classification in CAMELS
papers.summary: Graph neural networks classify galaxies into cosmic-web environments in CAMELS, reaching macro F1 about 0.65 and transferring across hydrodynamical simulations, outperforming an MLP.

papers.title: UNIONS and Euclid: Calibrating point source-galaxy separation for ground-based surveys
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in A&A. Some material is available online on https://github.com/GFThomas/StarGal_ground_Euclid
papers.summary: Euclid data train and validate a neural-network star-galaxy classifier for UNIONS imaging, reaching 80% purity at r~24 where curve-of-growth methods fail.
papers.topic: Source Detection, Deblending and Image Simulation

papers.title: PINN-Slicer: Exploiting Rotational Symmetry to Solve the Photon Orbit Equation Around a Black Hole
papers.comment: 11 pages, 14 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 9th Workshop on Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences (ML4PS 2026). Code: https://github.com/soot-bit/pinnslicer
papers.summary: Physics-informed neural network with symmetry-based slicing solves the photon-orbit equation around a Schwarzschild black hole, reaching RMSE below 1e-3 without retraining for new initial conditions.

papers.title: Towards three-dimensional dark matter mapping in the extended solar neighbourhood with Gaia Data Release 3 and deep learning
papers.comment: 17 pages, 15 figures, accepted for publication in MNRAS on the Nov. 24, 2026
papers.summary: Deep learning maps Gaia DR3 stellar kinematics to local dark matter density using FIRE-2 simulations, yielding 0.80–1.12 GeV cm−3 estimates.

papers.title: Toward Automated Strong-Lens Modeling with Agentic Workflows: An Application to Euclid Q1 Lenses
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. The lens-model catalog and diagnostic plots are available at https://github.com/caoxiaoyue/lens-orchestra. The full codebase will be released upon acceptance
papers.summary: Lens-Orchestra couples multimodal LLM agents to forward strong-lens modeling, autonomously fitting 149 Euclid Q1 lenses and recovering Einstein radii and density slopes.

papers.title: NuSrcAgent: An AI Agent for High-Energy Neutrino Source Searches
papers.comment: Main text 12 pages, 8 figures, and appendices. Comments are welcome. Code available at github.com/beizhouphys/NuSrcAgent
papers.summary: NuSrcAgent is a public AI agent that runs IceCube neutrino source likelihood analyses from natural-language requests, reproducing single-source and stacking results and enabling new analyses.
